import type { LinkContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import type { ReactNode, MouseEventHandler } from 'react';
export interface LinkProps extends LinkContract {
    children?: ReactNode;
    onClick?: MouseEventHandler<HTMLAnchorElement>;
}
export declare function Link({ href, label, target, rel, disabled, appearance, size, underline, children, onClick }: LinkProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
